paper_title: Do direct detection experiments constrain axionlike particles coupled to electrons?
suggested_experiment_name: X-ray/gamma-ray indirect limits on ALP DM lifetime (NuSTAR/XMM/INTEGRAL)
notes: This is a theory/reinterpretation paper arguing that ALPs coupled to electrons in the keV-MeV range decay radiatively too quickly to be dark matter, thus invalidating direct detection limits (GERDA, EDELWEISS-III, SuperCDMS, Majorana). It does not present its own new measured exclusion limit; it derives a lifetime-based exclusion region and cites astrophysical X-ray/gamma-ray constraints. The coupling discussed is g_ae (AxionElectron), but no tabulated numerical (mass, g_ae) limit curve is provided — only a figure (Fig. 2) with axis ranges (ma ~0.005-1 MeV, gae ~10^-21 to 10^-11).
